finding: Both playable exteriors reproduce broad proportions. The owner rejected their likeness to the original designs.
comparison: Studio views use the playable OBJ exterior only. The camera direction approximates the original by eye. Game captures show the additional boarding fixtures and real finishes.
review: Proposed: compare revised geometry with the selected original at its three-quarter angle, then check the sides and stern before game integration.
status: Original and current geometry compared. No replacement in the playable build.

delta-tree.name: Delta Tree
delta-tree.in_art: Curved, raised branch walls enclose deep leaf-shaped recesses. Round docks rise from their tips. A tiered bridge and individually shrouded drives rise behind the fan.
delta-tree.in_game: Straight spokes meet small discs on a solid wedge. Several disappear into the deck. Three rows of plain cylinders form the exposed engines.
delta-tree.first_correction: Build the negative spaces and curved, widening spine into the deck. Model the drive collars, housings and stepped bridge against the original.

glacier-tongue.name: Glacier Tongue
glacier-tongue.in_art: Silver plates overlap in separate waves over blue armor. A recessed hangar and crossing galleries sit under the hull beside a deep outboard blade.
glacier-tongue.in_game: Most plate edges follow the same smooth curve. Narrow rods connect a thin rail. The side lacks the stepped walls and mechanical depth around the hangar.
glacier-tongue.first_correction: Model the wave and overhang of each armor tier, the framed bay behind it, and the broad blade with enclosed crossings.
